# infisical_instance_deployment_aws_metadata (Data Source)

Read details about the AWS account the Infisical instance runs as, such as the account ID to trust in an IAM role's trust policy. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
    aws = {
      source = "hashicorp/aws"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_instance_deployment_aws_metadata" "this" {}

# Trust policy for an IAM role that an Infisical AWS App Connection assumes.
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "infisical_trust" {
  statement {
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${data.infisical_instance_deployment_aws_metadata.this.account_id}:root"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = ["<your-infisical-project-id>"]
    }
  }
}

output "infisical_aws_account_id" {
  value = data.infisical_instance_deployment_aws_metadata.this.account_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account ID Infisical acts as when it assumes an IAM role in your AWS account, for example for an AWS App Connection. Name this account as the trusted principal in the role's trust policy. Null when the instance has no AWS identity.
